mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of supply chain disruption (indicated by INDPRO below 100.0), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS above 100,000 jobs) consistently signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth > 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 5.0%, it triggers central bank tightening expectations that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 below 2.0% annualized) indicates a deteriorating economic outlook, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when HOUST declines and GDPC1 < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 consecutive months.
